CreateMultiOrder.description_en: Places, renews, or modifies orders for specific products of Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise Edition, such as monthly duration packages
CreateMultiOrder.description_zh: 本接口为无影云电脑企业版按月时长包等部分商品的下单、续费、变配接口

DescribeCreditPackageAgents.description_en: Queries the list of Agents and usage summary information under the current username
DescribeCreditPackageAgents.description_zh: 查询当前用户名下的Agent列表及用量汇总信息

DescribeCreditUsageInfo.description_en: Queries credit usage details by a specified dimension such as user, credit package, or agent
DescribeCreditUsageInfo.description_zh: 按指定维度查询用户、积分包或Agent的积分使用情况

DescribeDeductionStatistic.description_en: Retrieves resource deduction and usage statistics based on specified conditions
DescribeDeductionStatistic.description_zh: 获取指定条件下的资源抵扣和使用情况统计

DescribeMultiPrice.description_en: Queries the prices of Elastic Desktop Service products, including prices for new purchases, renewals, specification changes, and unsubscriptions
DescribeMultiPrice.description_zh: 查询无影商品的价格，包括新购、续费、变配及退订等订单类型

DescribePackageDeductions.description_en: Queries the deduction details of a core-hour package

ModifyInstanceProperties.description_en: Modifies the attributes of an instance

SetAgentCreditQuota.description_en: Sets the credit usage quota for a specified Agent
SetAgentCreditQuota.description_zh: 用于为指定的Agent设置积分使用额度
